summary: HSPnetPager is a custom ASP.NET WebControl providing paging functionality for displaying large lists of items in a paged format. It handles state persistence, postback events, rendering of page navigation controls, toggling between paged and 'show all' views, and offers utilities for managing page and item calculations.
purpose: To enable web applications to display records in paged formats, allowing users to navigate between pages of results efficiently, toggle between paged and all-record views, and display navigation controls including previous/next buttons and numeric page selection.

fields.name: ItemCount
fields.description: Total number of items to be paged.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.description: Row index at start of current page: pageIndex(CurrentIndex) * PageSize.

fields.name: RowsDisplayed
fields.description: Number of rows displayed on the current page.

workflows.name: Page Rendering and Navigation
steps: Persist and restore pager state via SaveControlState and LoadControlState.
Render navigation table using Render method.
Calculate pager start/end indexes for visible page buttons.
Generate navigation controls: Previous button, Next button, numeric page buttons, ellipsis for skippable pages.
Handle postback events for page navigation.
Update CurrentIndex and recalculate PageCount as needed.
Toggle between 'Show All' and paged mode based on PageSize and item count.
Update paging captions and visibility for navigation UI.

business_rules: If ItemCount < PageSize, display only one page.
PageCount is calculated as ceiling(ItemCount / PageSize).
Show All mode is achieved by setting PageSize to a very large value.
Paging captions are hidden if item count does not require paging.
validations: Ensure page index and item counts are within expected range.
Validate UUID format for document linking if necessary.
calculations: RowsDisplayed = for last page: ItemCount - StartRow; otherwise: PageSize
conditions: If ItemCount <= PageSize: only one page is shown.
If CurrentIndex < PageCount: Next button enabled; otherwise disabled.
If CurrentIndex > 1: Previous button enabled; otherwise disabled.
If ItemCount < defaultPageSize: paging caption hidden.
system_behavior: Renders navigation controls dynamically based on current state.
Maintains paging state across page reloads.
exceptions: Setting CurrentIndex greater than PageCount resets CurrentIndex to PageCount.
Invalid UUIDs for document linking are excluded.
content_gaps: No explicit UI markup for how pager is placed on the page.
No details about accessibility or customization hooks.
No explicit error handling for edge cases (e.g., negative Index, zero PageSize).
